poc_requirement: Mandatory for all severities: Foundry test in the repo suite at the frozen commit, or a local Anvil fork of Arbitrum Sepolia; mocks may only replace out-of-scope components (Pyth, USDG)
trust_model: Admin/owner is trusted (Panther criteria): a path that only a trusted role can trigger is not a payable finding on its own. Keepers are NOT trusted: anyone may execute orders, liquidations, price updates and protection as a keeper, and harm in that role is in scope.
